text.en:
The Secretary of Justice is hereby authorized to acquire by purchase the papers, documents, and
other printed works and unpublished manuscripts concerning the Philippines, as well as the curios of the
libraries and collections of Eduardo de Lete and the late Epifanio de los Santos, which shall upon their
acquisition be preserved in the Philippine Library and Museum. The Secretary of Justice shall make a careful
investigation and decide which books, documents, papers, unpublished manuscripts, and curios shall be

The sum of twenty thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1928.
